project_type: React SPA with Firebase backend (Auth + Firestore)
verification_instructions: Run NODE_OPTIONS= npx tsc --noEmit to confirm zero type errors. No npm install is possible in this sandbox.
setup_instructions: No setup needed; dependencies already installed. TypeScript checking is the primary verification.
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no npm install, no external HTTP. Only git push to GitHub is possible. Verify with tsc --noEmit only.
contribution_requirements: Commit to ui/home-story-redesign branch. Use existing component library (shadcn/ui, lucide-react, framer-motion, tailwindcss). Keep dark theme. Maintain compatibility with AuthProvider and routing.
key_patterns: Lazy-loaded pages in src/App.tsx. AuthProvider context provides { user, profile, signOut, refreshProfile }. firebase.ts exports auth/db/storage/googleProvider. shadcn Sheet for drawers. framer-motion AnimatePresence for transitions. cn() from @/lib/utils for conditional classNames. IconBtn local helper in Profile.tsx. SideMenu uses Sheet from shadcn. Reels uses IntersectionObserver for video autoplay. MessagesPasscodeGate wraps Messages routes.
directory_structure: src/pages/ - route-level components. src/components/ - shared UI (layout/, messages/, social/, vibe/, profile/, creator/, ui/). src/contexts/ - AuthProvider, ThemeProvider, CallProvider. src/lib/ - utilities, firebase config. src/hooks/ - custom hooks. src/features/ - feature-specific modules.
